submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"

finding.headline: "The No-Appetite Post-Surgery Mama"
finding.problem: "My stomach is empty but food disgusts me. I'm healing from major surgery and I can't eat. I'm scared my milk will dry up."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 32-yr-old mum 10 days after emergency C-section, appetite gone, nausea, living on sips; knows she must eat to heal and make milk but can't face a plate.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module inside C-section product / Standalone — "Liquid Courage: Smoothies, Pap & Broths for When You Can't Chew."". Verdict: PASSES (19/25)..
